articles.summary: 100% of the Hammer Price of the Iconic 1975 MasterCraft Stars Stripes Boat with Matching Custom Chevrolet Colorado by RealTruck will go to Building Homes for Heroes Multi-Platinum Selling Country Singer Warren Zeiders Will Step Onto the Auction Block to Help Sell the Pairing MasterCraft Boat Company , a subsidiary of MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc (NASDAQ: MCFT) and the best-selling towboat brand, and RealTruck , America's leading truck accessory brand, today announced at Specialty Equipment Market Association Show (SEMA) that the reimagined and customized Chevrolet Colorado paired with MasterCraft’s iconic 1975 “Stars Stripes” ski boat will be up for auction during Barrett-Jackson’s 2027 Scottsdale Auction, January 23-31 at WestWorld of Scottsdale. This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261103802211/en/ MasterCraft’s restored 1975 “Stars Stripes” ski boat makes its debut at the 2026 SEMA Show
articles.title: MasterCraft & RealTruck’s Custom Truck-and-Boat Build to Be Auctioned for Charity During Barrett-Jackson’s 2027 Scottsdale Auction

articles.summary: New and Expanded Dealer Partnerships Strengthen Brand Presence and Customer Access Across North America and Europe MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc. (MCBH) today announced continued dealer network expansion across its portfolio of brands during the Q1 2026 Transition Period, reflecting the company’s continued investment in its brands, distribution network, and long-term growth. Through new partnerships and expanded brand representation with established marine dealerships, MCBH is broadening customer access to its boats while strengthening its market position and building a foundation for future growth. “Expanding our dealer network is an important part of our long-term vision for MCBH and our family of brands,” said Brad Nelson, Chief Executive Officer of MasterCraft Boat Holdings. “By partnering with strong local dealers, we're making it easier for more boaters to experience our products with the support that makes boat ownership rewarding. We remain focused on investing in our brands
articles.title: MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc., Expands Dealer Network Across its Portfolio During Q1 2026 Transition Period
